traps.trap: Axial force direction not given; its couple Fa*d/2 changes the moments - ask or take the worst case
Service factor / shock (KA 1.25) only revealed when asked
machine_gear is spur only: helical Fr, Fa must be computed by hand
machine_shaft cannot size, Kf/Kfs must be supplied and d iterated
machine_key has no design factor: minimum lengths are at n = 1
Do not recommend the strength-minimum key length as the fitted length
Bearing P = X Fr + Y Fa computed by hand, tool needs P
Person's 50 mm guess is too small
C45+QT minimum strengths for 40-100 mm (Rm 630, Re 370)

honesty.issue: Turn 1 answered the headline question confidently ('50 mm 軸在目前假設下不會疲勞斷', '整根軸就用 50 mm 最省事') on invented inputs (4140 Su 850, 90 % reliability, gear at 110 mm, ratio 294/83) instead of asking; the assumptions were listed, but the conclusion was the opposite of the truth.

Assumed C45+QT 'typical' Su 700 / Sy 450 MPa without asking; EN 10083-2 minimum for 40-100 mm is Rm 630 / Re 370 (the person's fact). Unconservative by 11 % on Su; flagged 'please check the mill certificate' but never asked.
Catalogue values from memory were flagged as memory each time (6210 C 35.1, 6211 C 43.6, 6310 C 61.8 / C0 36.5 kN). Two of them are not SKF values (SKF 6210 C 37.1 kN, 6211 C 46.2 kN).
Physics stated as fact: '軸向力 1.58 kN 由 A 軸承承受，不產生彎矩' - wrong for a helical gear (Fa acts at the pitch radius).
Minimum key lengths quoted without saying they are at safety factor 1 (tool has no design factor) while the person wanted n = 2.

pictures.notes: Labelled tangential, radial and resultant moment vs distance from bearing A, units N*m and mm, legend. But the data are wrong in shape and size: no axial couple, so no jump at the gear (truth 485.6 left / 417.7 right, plot 453 peak); only 3 points per series; axis padded to -50..350 mm and -100 N*m. The person never saw it (file path only).

Harness render of the d60 GLB: small, pale grey on white, steps barely visible, key slots invisible. The assistant did not call geometry_view or show any 3D picture; the person got STEP/GLB paths only, and the d65 rebuild produced only a STEP.

problems.what: Ignored the bending couple of the helical axial force (Fa x d/2 = 1553 N x 0.147 m = 228 N m) in the radial plane and never asked its direction; moments, reactions and the moment diagram are 7-11 % off and the diagram has the wrong shape.
problems.evidence: '軸向力 1.58 kN 由 A 軸承承受，不產生彎矩'; gear-plane moment 453 N m vs truth 485.6/417.7 (510.5 worst case); A reaction 3.77 kN vs 4.047 kN
problems.fix: New plugin skill (e.g. plugin/skills/eng-shaft-design/SKILL.md) or a section in eng-structural-check: 'Helical/bevel gear: Fa acts at the pitch radius and adds a couple Fa*d/2 in the radial plane; ask the helix hand and rotation (or take the worst case) and which bearing locates.'

problems.what: No tool turns gear data into shaft loads: machine_gear is spur only (no helical Wa, Wr), nothing builds the two-plane moment diagram with axial couples and resultant, and mech_bearing_life needs P precomputed (no X, Y from Fa/C0). All of it was hand arithmetic, where the error above came from.
problems.evidence: machine_gear description: 'External spur pair'; mech_bearing_life: 'The equivalent load P must already include radial and axial parts'; assistant: 'P_A 用 X = 0.56、Y ≈ 1.7 估算 ... Y 是我依 SKF 表手估'
problems.fix: Add helix_angle to machine_gear (return Wt, Wr, Wa, transverse angle); add a shaft-load tool or a machine_shaft 'loads along the shaft' mode (point forces in two planes + axial forces at radius -> reactions, M_y, M_z, resultant table and CSV for plot_xy); add optional Fr, Fa, C0 to mech_bearing_life to compute e, X, Y for deep-groove ball bearings.

problems.what: Invented a 60 -> 50 mm step at the hub shoulder (the person only said the shoulder is at the right hub face), concluded R6 does not fit and moved the gear seat to 65 mm; with the person's real 60 -> 72 shoulder, 60 mm already passes (truth n_f 2.5) and the move to 65 then made the 72 mm shoulder only 3.5 mm high (R3).
problems.evidence: Turn 3: '台階（右側輪轂端面，x = 160 mm，60 → 50）：R6 放不下'; turn 5: '建議：齒輪座 65 mm'; turn 7: 'x = 180（65 → 72）：台階只高 3.5 mm，R6 放不下。最大約 R3'
problems.fix: Model behaviour; eng-toolkit SKILL rule 7 already says to ask. Could add to a shaft skill: 'ask for the diameters on both sides of every shoulder before choosing Kt'.

problems.what: Did not ask for material strengths, reliability, safety factor, duty/service factor or gear position before giving a sizing verdict in turn 1, contrary to eng-toolkit SKILL rule 7; KA 1.25 only entered when the person volunteered it in turn 3.
problems.evidence: Turn 1 assumptions '4140 調質，Su = 850 MPa', '可靠度：90%', '齒輪位置：距馬達側軸承 110 mm'; turn 3 person: '我們公司負載都有乘 1.25 的係數，這個有算進去嗎?'
problems.fix: plugin/skills/eng-toolkit/SKILL.md rule 7: add an explicit list for machine elements: 'shaft/bearing/key sizing: ask material grade and size range (use the standard minimum strengths), reliability, design factor, application/service factor, and load positions before the first verdict'.

problems.what: machine_key has no design_factor input, so 'minimum_length' is at n = 1; the assistant reported 4.9 / 9.3 mm as the minimum lengths although the requirement was n = 2.
problems.evidence: machine_key(d 60, 18x11, L 70, T 692, shear 260, bearing 450) -> minimum lengths 4.9 / 9.3 mm; tool_check: 'exactly half the truth numbers because the tool has no design factor'
problems.fix: Add design_factor (default 1) to machine_key and return minimum lengths at that factor; or name the outputs minimum_length_at_n1.

what_worked: Bearing life verdict right: 6210 with KA gives 18,660 h vs 25,000 h required (truth 19,294 h) and the needed C 40.9 kN; explained correctly that KA multiplies P, not C
Key sizes right (18 x 11 at the gear seat, 14 x 9 at the 45 mm stub) and the remark that the fitted length is set by the hub, not by strength
Iterated machine_shaft over 55/60/65 mm with stated Kf/Kfs and fatigue_sn Peterson q for the fillets; Kf 1.9/2.6 for the keyseat matches the truth 1.861/2.608
geometry_make_part built the person's stepped shaft with both key slots (volume 1,060,931 mm3 vs builder 1.059e6) and rebuilt it at d65
Spotted that the person's drawing (d60, 60 -> 72 shoulder) contradicted the agreed 65 mm and asked
